**Camera**

- Firmware version (if known):

**How GPS is stored (if you know)**
- Separate log file next to the MP4 (e.g. `GPSData*.txt`, `*.nmea`, `*.gpx`)?
- Embedded in the MP4/MOV/TS?
- Folder layout on the SD card (Front/Rear/Interior, Normal/Event, ...):

**Sample**
Support cannot be written from a description alone - it needs a real sample:
a few clips copied straight off the SD card - every file next to the videos
included, original names and folder structure, all channels, nothing
re-encoded or trimmed. If the camera can show GPS (coordinates/speed) on the
video, switch that on: it is what support is checked against.

Attaching or linking it right here is fine **if you are okay with it being
public** (the recording shows where you drive; attachments cannot reliably
be removed later). Prefer to keep it private? Email it (or a download link)
to **feedback@dashcamigo.app** with a link to this issue.

By sharing a sample you confirm the recording is yours to share and can be
used to build and test support for it. The recording itself never enters
the repository - everything that lands there is anonymized first
(coordinates rounded, video replaced).

**Anything else**
Links to the file format, other tools that read this camera, etc.
